# renmods

An R package to download, import, and filter data from [B.C.’s Environmental Monitoring Data System](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/environment/research-monitoring-reporting/monitoring/environmental-monitoring-data-system) (EnMoDs) into R. The 'renmods' package replaces 'rems' to support the new data system released in March 2026. 

The EnMoDs dataset is licensed under the [Open Government Licence - British Columbia](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content?id=A519A56BC2BF44E4A008B33FCF527F61).

### Features
- Download EnMoDS data and cache locally
- Converts to Parquet files for speedy connections and filtering
- Straightforward data connections, only to as much data as required to speed up load times.


### Installation

If installing on Linux, see the troubleshooting section below for a faster method.

```{r install}
#| eval: false
# install.packages("pak") # if not already installed

library(pak)
pkg_install("bcgov/renmods")
```

### Updating
After updating, it's recommended to remove your cache and re-download the data.
The downloads will take a bit of time, but this will ensure there are no complications due to the update.

Note that you will get a warning if you try to work with data downloaded with a different version of renmods, and an error if it is so different that we have a metadata mismatch.

```{r}
#| eval: false
library(renmods)
cache_remove()
renmods_update("all")
```

### Usage

See the [Get Started](https://bcgov.github.io/renmods/articles/renmods.html) tutorial for details

### Troubleshooting

**Installing duckdb on Linux is so slow!!!**

Solution: First install duckdb from the Posit Public Package Manager for Linux,
then continue on with your installation of renmods.

(ref: https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb-r#installation-from-cran)

```{r}
#| eval: false
install.packages(
  "duckdb",
  repos = sprintf(
    "https://p3m.dev/cran/latest/bin/linux/manylinux_2_28-%s/%s",
    R.version["arch"],
    substr(getRversion(), 1, 3)
  )
)
```
